BiblicalUsage: The word ʼĔlûwl carries the sense of the sixth Jewish month. In Nehemiah 6:15, the text says "So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth [day] of [the month] Elul."
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʼĕlûwl as it stands: the sixth Jewish month.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
